title: Te Mura i Whakakite i te Taonga Tuku Iho
intro: I roto i ngā pukapuka o te ātete, kei reira tētahi tangata e tū ana, ko tōna ingoa tonu i waiho hei whakatūpato mō te mutunga o te wā. I whiriwhiria e tēnei tangata te mauahara i te whanaungatanga, te whakakeke i te ngohengohe, ā, i tū hei whakahē i te karanga aroha. Whakarongo mai ki ngā reo o tētahi panuitanga tawhito i a tātou e huraina ana te tuakiri o tēnei wairua kino.
clues: I whānau mai ahau i roto i te iwi kotahi me te karere whakamutunga a Allah, heoi i tū atu ahau ki a rātou i ngā wā katoa.
He ingoa tōku—he ingoa e tohu ana i tōku mutunga mutunga kore.
I tukuna e au te kino ki te kaimau o te pono, ā, i uru mai hoki tōku ake whare ki tēnei pakanga nanakia.
I whakamahia e au aku taonga me tōku mana ki te whakamutu i te karanga ki a Allah, me te whakapono ka taea e te moni te tineia te māramatanga atua.
I whakatapua e Allah tētahi upoko katoa māku—he upoko poto rawa e taea ai te whakahua i roto i ngā hēkona, engari ka mau tonu tōna taumaha tae noa ki te Rā Whakawakanga.
Kei muri i ahau taku hoa i te ao tūroa, e here ana ki te taura muka i te kaki, e waha ana i ngā tataramoa i horahia e rātou.
